mapper.select: select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, a.id, a.title, a.boardId, a.visitCount, a.likeCount, a.replyCount, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime from t_user u, t_article a where u.id = a.userId and a.deleteState = 0 order by a.createTime desc;

select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, a.id, a.title, a.boardId, a.visitCount, a.likeCount, a.replyCount, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime from t_user u, t_article a where u.id = a.userId and a.deleteState = 0 and a.boardId = #{boardId,jdbcType=BIGINT} order by a.createTime desc;

select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, u.gender as u_gender, u.isAdmin as u_isAdmin, u.state as u_state, u.deleteState as u_deleteState, b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, b.state as b_state, b.deleteState as b_deleteState, a.id, a.title, a.content, a.visitCount, a.likeCount, a.replyCount, a.state, a.deleteState, a.createTime, a.updateTime from t_user u, t_article a, t_board b where a.id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.userId = u.id and a.boardId = b.id and a.deleteState = 0;
